note: Open component grammar — five starting atoms. Any pair may attempt bind; failures are craft tells. Not a closed recipe catalog.

atoms.label: Light
atoms.role: lamp wash / sight-line / chalk that shows
atoms.tell: soft disk with a ray nick

atoms.label: Matter
atoms.role: mass / peg / timber body that pins

atoms.label: Time
atoms.role: beat / dwell / period — workshop interval, never rewind
atoms.ban: Refuse clock-magic loot and violet shards

atoms.label: Space
atoms.role: gap / span length / extent that holds open

combine_affinity.label: Sight-line
combine_affinity.tell: Light draws a line through open air.

combine_affinity.label: Lamp seat
combine_affinity.tell: Lamp seats on mass — the shed answers.

combine_affinity.label: Charge cord
combine_affinity.tell: Push stored in body — cord hums.

combine_affinity.label: Flow channel
combine_affinity.tell: Energy wants a path through the gap.

combine_affinity.label: Pulse beat
combine_affinity.tell: Beat meets push — the gate learns a period.

combine_affinity.label: Period gate
combine_affinity.tell: Interval spans the gap — cross on the beat.
Dwell weight — the beat won't lift that mass.
Glare wash — too bright to stitch.
Afterimage stutter — the stitch shears mid-travel.
Overload tear — two pushes refuse one cord.
Two beats desync — snap white, settle chalk.
Washout — light on light leaves no seam.

default_unknown.tell: The loom tries — these atoms quarrel without a name yet.
